connector.name: Foxit PDF API MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: MCP server that exposes Foxit PDF API capabilities via stdio.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package foxit-pdf-api-mcp-server. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the foxitsoftware account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: FOXIT_CLOUD_API_HOST
env.description: Foxit PDF Services host, e.g. https://na1.fusion.foxit.com/pdf-services

env.name: FOXIT_CLOUD_API_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Client ID for Foxit PDF API from foxit developer portal(https://developer-api.foxit.com/)

env.name: FOXIT_CLOUD_API_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: Client secret for Foxit PDF API from foxit developer portal(https://developer-api.foxit.com/)
